changes.what: VERVE-102's mid-stage trial (HEART-3) started enrolling patients.
changes.why: A one-time gene-editing treatment meant to lower LDL for life.

changes.what: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Halts Pelacarsen After Trial Miss As Ianalumab Data Impresses
changes.why: A monthly shot that lowers Lp(a). It was the first Lp(a) drug to finish a large final-stage trial.

extra.summary: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Halts Pelacarsen After Trial Miss As Ianalumab Data Impresses Yahoo Finance

changes.what: FDA Adds a Vision Warning to Zepbound Days After Lilly’s November 6 Hims & Hers Deal
changes.why: A weekly shot that acts on two gut hormones (GIP and GLP-1) to reduce appetite. Sold as Zepbound for weight and Mounjaro for diabetes.

extra.summary: FDA Adds a Vision Warning to Zepbound Days After Lilly’s November 6 Hims & Hers Deal Yahoo Finance

changes.what: FDA adds vision loss warning to Ozempic, Wegovy and other GLP-1 drugs
changes.why: The first of the new weight-loss drugs: a weekly GLP-1 shot, now also a daily pill. Sold as Ozempic for diabetes.

extra.summary: FDA adds vision loss warning to Ozempic, Wegovy and other GLP-1 drugs TMJ4 News

changes.what: China approves Eli Lilly’s oral weight-loss drug orforglipron
changes.why: Lilly's GLP-1 pill. Unlike other GLP-1 pills it doesn't need to be taken on an empty stomach, and it's easier to make in bulk than shots.

extra.summary: China approves Eli Lilly’s oral weight-loss drug orforglipron Minute Mirror

changes.why: One antibody that does two jobs: unleashes the immune system (PD-1) and starves tumors of blood supply (VEGF).
